facts.business: Arka Defence & Locomotives Limited (formerly Source Industries (India) Limited) is transitioning into heavy engineering with focus on specialized defensive equipment systems and locomotive component engineering.
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 and details have been disclosed in the financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards. The Policy on Related Party Transactions is available on the company website.
